title: Tile-based cohort sculpting for robust quantization validation
creator: Rafael Ortega
description:
Purpose: Define and implement a reproducible, domain-aware sampling strategy for building per-domain calibration packs used in INT8/FP8 quantization and subsequent accuracy validation. This work focuses on a tile-based cohortization approach that preserves distributional signal from production prompts while enabling efficient holdout/validation partitions and stress-case injection (rare intents, long-context behavior, KV cache boundaries).

Background: Existing calibration packs often over-index on frequent short prompts and miss corner cases that matter for downstream quality after quantization (e.g., long-context token distributions, domain-specific tokenization artifacts, and conditional probability tails). Prior tickets explored stratified and reservoir approaches; this task introduces a "tile" abstraction: slice production traffic into orthogonal signal tiles (domain, seq_length_bucket, recentness, tenant_weight, prefix-fingerprint) and sample within tiles with configurable density and augmentation.

Goals:
- Produce a deterministic pipeline that generates per-domain calibration packs (pack metadata + sample list) suitable for FP8/INT8 calibration and for held-out validation runs.
- Ensure packs cover: short/frequent prompts, tail/rare intents, long-context (>2048 tokens), cache-warm vs cache-cold scenarios, and tenant-skewed behaviors.
- Allow pluggable injection of synthetic variants (redactions, extended context, permutation) to stress quantized kernels.
- Target pack sizes configurable by domain (default 3k examples/domain) with a sampling budget allocator that respects traffic volume and signal importance.
- Provide metrics to detect sampling drift vs production distribution and automatic alerts when packs become stale.

Design summary (tile-based cohortization):
1) Define tile axes: domain (service/domain tag), seq_length_bucket (0-64, 65-256, 257-1024, 1025-4096+), recency_bucket (last 24h, 1-7d, 7-30d, >30d), tenant_quantile (top 5%, mid 80%, tail 15%), prefix_hash_bucket (N=1024), and intent_cluster (optional embedding cluster).
2) For each domain, compute tile counts from sampled production traffic over a configurable window (default 14 days).
3) Allocate sampling budget per tile using a hybrid scoring function: score = alpha * normalized_traffic + beta * rarity_boost + gamma * model_uncertainty_metric + delta * tenant_weight. Tunable defaults: alpha=0.6, beta=0.2, gamma=0.15, delta=0.05.
4) Within a tile, perform reservoir sampling with LRU de-duplication by prompt hash and optional exemplar anchoring for high-value prompts.
5) Add targeted stress injection: synthetic-context-extension (for long-context tests), masked-redaction variants (PII handling paths), and negative-sample pairs for reranking/eval tasks.
6) Produce deterministic output with a fixed seed per generation run; publish pack manifest with provenance (generation_timestamp, traffic_window, tile_allocations, random_seed, generator_version).

Evaluation & Acceptance Metrics:
- Coverage: fraction of tiles with >= 1 sample should be >= 95% for domains with >1k daily requests.
- Distribution fidelity: KL divergence of seq_length distribution between pack and production sample <= 0.12 (configurable per domain).
- Rare-intent recall: at least 80% of annotated rare intents (as defined by intent cluster frequency < 0.1%) should have at least one exemplar across pack and injected variants.
- Quantization delta budget: end-to-end application-level metrics (per-domain) must be captured by validation harness — e.g., top-1 token probability mean shift, top-k overlap, and a domain-specific metric (e.g., API-level completion quality) differences recorded.
- Reproducibility: running the generator with same seed and inputs must yield identical manifest and sample list.

Instrumentation & Outputs:
- Pack manifest JSON (simple list of prompt IDs + provenance fields).
- Sampling diagnostics dashboard: tile fill rates, top tiles by allocated budget, rejected duplicates, synthetic injection counts, and drift alerts.
- Hooks for downstream validation pipeline: holdout split generator, labeled-subset export for human review, and automated eval job links.

Risks & tradeoffs:
- Overfitting to production window: short windows may miss seasonal intents; include backfill and time-decay tuning.
- Tenant privacy: must ensure redaction/PII policies applied before any externalization. For Private deployments, support local-only pack generation.
- Size vs coverage: small pack budgets may under-represent tails; introduce adaptive minimums for low-volume domains.

Next steps / Implementation plan:
- Week 1: Implement tile extraction job and tile-count aggregator; land schema for pack manifest (ENG-431256-1).
- Week 2: Implement sampling allocator and reservoir sampler with deterministic seeding; add de-duplication and exemplar anchoring (ENG-431256-2).
- Week 3: Integrate synthetic injection modules and tie into validation harness; instrument dashboards and create alert rules (ENG-431256-3).
- Week 4: Run smoke calibration + INT8/FP8 quantization roundtrip on three pilot domains, collect metrics, and iterate.

Deliverables:
- Reusable sampling library (python + airflow job), pack manifest exporter, dashboard panels, and RFC describing scoring defaults for alpha/beta/gamma/delta.

updates: 2026-02-21: Kickoff meeting with Runtime and Eval teams. Agreed on tile axes and default budget (3k/domain). Lina to own implementation.
2026-02-26: Initial tile-count aggregator landed in staging (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/221). Running on 14d window for pilot domains: payments, docs, support-bot.
2026-03-03: Reservoir sampler prototype complete; deterministic seeding validated. Observed high duplication in prefix_hash_bucket=0; added LRU de-dup logic.
2026-03-08: Synthetic long-context injection module merged (adds +10% long-context variants); started INT8 roundtrip runs on pilot domains.
2026-03-10: First validation results: KL(seq_len) for payments domain = 0.09 (within target). Rare-intent recall 72% — need sharper rarity boost (beta -> 0.3).
acceptance_criteria: Sampling pipeline produces per-domain pack manifests and sample lists with provenance metadata.
Diagnostic dashboard surfaces tile fill, duplicates, and injection counts with alerting on drift.
Pilot domains completed an INT8/FP8 validation roundtrip with documented metrics and meeting thresholds defined above.
Automated reproducible generation via CI with fixed seeds and a smoke test that compares manifests.
Privacy checks and export gating in place (redaction, KMS encryption for non-local exports).
comments: PM feedback (Jasmin Patel): please ensure pack generation exposes per-tenant breakdown for enterprise customers to support Dedicated calibration workflows.
Design note (Marco Nguyen): when showing tile fill rates on dashboards, show relative tile importance (score) to avoid confusion between absolute counts and allocated budget.
Eng review (Tariq Hassan): suggest adding a fallback that forces min 5 samples for any tile with >1000 daily requests to avoid empty tiles from strict de-duplication.
